items.text: Senior Backend Engineer with 7 years of experience building high-throughput distributed microservices, ledger systems, and event-driven APIs in Go and Java.

entries.heading: Senior Backend Engineer, Core Ledger | Meridian Pay | 2022 – Present

items.text: Designed and maintained 12 tier-0 payment clearing and double-entry ledger microservices in Go and Java 17 handling $18B in annualized payment volume.
Architected an event-driven settlement pipeline on Apache Kafka processing 45,000 events/sec across 64 partitions with automated dead-letter queues and consumer lag alerting.
Designed public REST and internal gRPC APIs for multi-currency merchant payouts, enforcing Protobuf schema backward compatibility in CI via buf breaking-change checks.
Partitioned a 14TB Postgres ledger table by settlement month and replaced sequential scans with partial composite B-tree indexes, dropping p99 write lock contention by 74%.
Eliminated duplicate wire disbursements during network partitions by enforcing client-supplied deduplication keys and transactional outbox rows committed atomically with balance debits.

Implemented singleflight request coalescing and jittered TTLs in front of Redis Cluster merchant rate-limit counters, surviving a 10x Black Friday traffic spike on hot merchant keys without database fallback.
Containerized 16 Java and Go services with Docker on AWS ECS and EKS, automating canary deployments and integration test gates via GitHub Actions.

Served as primary pager duty commander for tier-0 checkout services, coordinating live mitigation bridges during a regional PSP outage and authoring five-whys root-cause writeups with preventative action items.
Paired weekly with 4 early-career teammates on concurrency debugging and shepherded their architecture proposals from initial draft to production rollout.

entries.heading: Software Engineer, Platform Services | ParcelGrid Logistics | 2019 – 2022

items.text: Migrated a monolithic shipment tracking application into 8 bounded-context Java (Spring Boot) and Go microservices, cutting deployment lead time from biweekly trains to 15 minutes.
Built a Kafka Streams geofence ingestion service consuming 18,000 GPS pings/sec from carrier fleets with sub-second end-to-end delivery notifications.
Diagnosed PG autovacuum transaction ID wraparound risks and tuned PgBouncer connection pooling across 18 read replicas, reducing p95 query latency by 41%.
Instrumented Go and Java services with OpenTelemetry distributed tracing and Prometheus histograms, cutting p99 latency triage time in Grafana by 50%.
Wrote an internal Go CLI tool to inspect consumer offsets, replay dead-letter Kafka topics, and validate database schema migrations.
Built automated payment processor failover routing between Stripe and Adyen HTTP APIs when upstream 5xx error rates exceeded 3%.
Configured mutual TLS (mTLS) client certificates for outbound webhook delivery to partner bank HTTPS endpoints.
Partnered with Go-to-market operations to automate enterprise merchant onboarding webhooks and sandbox credential provisioning.
Coordinated with the European data sovereignty federation council to align audit log retention schedules with GDPR mandates.
Built an internal hackathon prototype in Vanilla JavaScript to visualize webhook retry trees for support agents.
Queried merchant fraud ring relationships using an offline Neo4j graph analysis script during quarterly compliance audits.
Maintained local Docker Compose environment files so backend engineers could spin up mocked dependencies on developer laptops.
Implemented spot-rate foreign exchange (FX) quote caching for cross-border GBP and EUR merchant settlements.
